newsitem.title: USA: Duke sees Oconee 1 S.C. nuke on line Tues..
newsitem.headline: Duke sees Oconee 1 S.C. nuke on line Tues..

text.p: Duke Power Co said Monday its 846 megawatt (MW) Oconee 1 nuclear power unit would return on line Tuesday after a steam pipe rupture shut the unit more than five months ago.
"It's heated up. We're looking to connect to the grid tomorrow sometime," said company spokesman Rick Zuercher.
The pipe burst on Sept 24 occurred in the non-nuclear side of Oconee's unit 2. The incident injured seven workers.
Zuercher said the company hopes the 846 MW unit 3 would begin startup later this month.
In the meantime, the 846 MW unit 2 was producing at full output.
Nuclear generation accounts for approximately two-thirds of Duke's electricity deliveries.
